mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(p.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(p.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(p.document_version_id) AS documentVersionId, RAWTOHEX(p.user_id) AS userId, RAWTOHEX(p.ai_task_id) AS aiTaskId, p.source_text AS sourceText, p.polished_text AS polishedText, p.accepted_text AS acceptedText, p.decision
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO edudoc_polish_result (id, document_id, document_version_id, user_id, ai_task_id, source_text, polished_text, decision)
SELECT HEXTORAW(#{r.id}), HEXTORAW(#{r.documentId}), HEXTORAW(#{r.documentVersionId}), HEXTORAW(#{r.userId}), HEXTORAW(#{r.aiTaskId}), #{r.sourceText, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{r.polishedText, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{r.decision} FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_polish_result p WHERE p.id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM edudoc_polish_result p WHERE p.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) AND p.decision IN ('ACCEPT', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY p.update_time DESC, p.create_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT JSON_VALUE(d.detail_json, '$.versionId') FROM edudoc_audit_log d WHERE d.action_type = 'POLISH_APPLIED' AND JSON_VALUE(d.detail_json, '$.polishId') = #{polishId} ORDER BY d.create_time
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_polish_result SET decision = #{decision}, accepted_text = #{acceptedText, jdbcType=CLOB} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND decision = 'PENDING'
